description: This file defines the Java interface PolicyQueryCommand, which extends PolicyCommand and provides a contract for querying policy states within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a method for setting headers and has a default method for returning the category as QUERY.

classes.name: PolicyQueryCommand
classes.description: An interface for commands that query the state of policies, extending the core PolicyCommand interface and adding query-specific behavior.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command, allowing headers to be specified.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, defaulting to Category.QUERY.
